# Projection fixtures

The dedicated tests reuse the accepted A hand inputs and B exported synthetic
builders. All energies in these tests are invented arithmetic fixtures and all
recognized software identities simulate already supplied inputs. They establish
no native execution or receipt authority.

Every bounded test run retains complete source snapshots of both helper modules,
the A hand examples, and this test module. Filled pair/scan sheets, components and
exact selected outputs are written to that job's pytest temporary directory.
The large case retains its small selected output and actual retained member count.
